issues.title: Content Sharing: Implement ContentSharePackage Model
issues.description: Create the core database model for content sharing with company FK, status tracking, and expiration logic.

issues.title: Content Sharing: Implement REST API Endpoints
issues.description: Build 6 API endpoints for content sharing: create share, list shares, update expiration, get shared packages, retrieve content access, record analytics.

issues.title: Completion Tracking Level 1: Implement ModuleProgress Model
issues.description: Create model to track basic completion metrics: text scroll %, video watched %, quiz passed, time spent, progress percentage.
acceptance_criteria: ModuleProgress model with all tracking fields

issues.title: Completion Tracking Level 1: Implement Video 95% Tracking
issues.description: Add JavaScript to detect when video has been watched 95% and mark module as complete for video content.
acceptance_criteria: Video timeupdate event listener captures playback progress
At 95% completion, POST to backend to mark complete
Handles multiple video formats (mp4, webm, m3u8)

issues.title: Completion Tracking Level 1: Implement Text Scroll Tracking
issues.description: Add JavaScript to detect 100% scroll on text content and mark module complete.
acceptance_criteria: Scroll event listener calculates scroll percentage
At 100% scroll, POST to backend to mark complete

issues.title: Completion Tracking Level 1: Block Next Module Until Current Completes
issues.description: Prevent progression to next module until all requirements of current module are satisfied.
acceptance_criteria: Next module button disabled until 100% progress
Visual indicator shows what's blocking (e.g., '3:45 min video remaining')
Supports partial completions (e.g., video watched but quiz not taken)

issues.title: Video Strategy: Resolve Storage & Security Decision
issues.description: Make final decision on video storage approach: YouTube only, S3 only, or Hybrid (YouTube + S3 + presigned URLs).
acceptance_criteria: Cost analysis for each approach at scale (1k hours, 10k hours, 100k hours)
Security comparison (anti-sharing requirements, DRM, LGPD/HIPAA compliance)

issues.title: Content Sharing: Build Manager Share Creation UI
issues.description: Create console page for managers to select courses/modules and create share packages with recipient selection.

issues.title: Content Sharing: Build User Dashboard for Received Shares
issues.description: Create student-facing dashboard showing all received share packages, access history, and quick-start buttons.
acceptance_criteria: List all received shares with metadata

issues.title: Content Sharing: Integrate Notifications System
issues.description: Send email notifications when share packages are created, updated, or expiring soon.
acceptance_criteria: Email sent on 7-day and 1-day before expiration

issues.title: Content Sharing: Implement Basic Analytics Tracking
issues.description: Track views, clicks, time spent per share package and expose in manager analytics dashboard.
acceptance_criteria: Record each access event with timestamp and user

issues.title: Completion Tracking Level 1: Build Progress Display UI
issues.description: Create progress bar component showing % complete with per-content breakdown (text, video, quiz status).
acceptance_criteria: Visual feedback (green for complete, yellow for partial, gray for not started)

issues.title: Quiz System: Add 'Select Existing Quiz' Feature
issues.description: Allow managers to add previously-created quizzes to modules instead of creating new ones each time.
acceptance_criteria: Handle quiz updates (changes reflected in linked modules)

issues.title: Quiz System: Handle Edge Cases & Retakes
issues.description: Implement quiz retake logic, answer review, and time limits.
acceptance_criteria: Show best score vs all attempts
Option to review answers after passing

issues.title: Completion Tracking Level 2: Implement ModuleRequirements Model
issues.description: Create model for customizable per-module requirements: min time, video %, text scroll %, quiz score, attempt limits, content order.
acceptance_criteria: Store content_order JSON (which to complete first)

issues.title: Completion Tracking Level 2: Implement Time Tracking Backend
issues.description: Track time spent per module and enforce minimum time requirements.
acceptance_criteria: Exclude time when user leaves (pause on blur)

issues.title: Completion Tracking Level 2: Build Admin Customization UI
issues.description: Console page for managers to configure completion requirements per module.
acceptance_criteria: Toggle quiz requirement and set min_score
Drag-drop to reorder content completion order

issues.title: Completion Tracking Level 3: Implement Certificate Generation
issues.description: Auto-generate PDF certificates when course is completed with student name, course title, date.
acceptance_criteria: Certificate model stores PDF file and validity dates
Trigger certificate generation on course completion
Include student name, course title, completion date

issues.title: Completion Tracking Level 3: Implement Immutable Audit Log
issues.description: Create AuditLog model to track all student learning activities (video_watched, quiz_passed, text_read, etc.) for compliance.
acceptance_criteria: AuditLog model with user, action, module, timestamp, details JSON
Log video watch events with percentage watched
Log quiz attempts with score and answers
Log text reads with scroll percentage
Admin can view audit trail per user

issues.title: Completion Tracking Level 3: Implement Course Enrollment with Deadlines
issues.description: Add CourseEnrollment model to track enrollment status, deadlines, and retraining schedules.
acceptance_criteria: CourseEnrollment model with enrollment date and deadline
Status tracking: enrolled, in_progress, completed, expired
Support retraining: auto-enroll after validity period (e.g., 6 months)
Dashboard shows enrollment status per user

issues.title: Completion Tracking Level 3: Build Admin Dashboard with Compliance Reporting
issues.description: Create dashboard showing course completion rates by user/department with export to PDF/CSV.
acceptance_criteria: Overview: X of Y users completed course
Filter by user, department, date range
Export to PDF with audit trail
Export to CSV for spreadsheet analysis

issues.title: Video Strategy: Implement AWS S3 Integration
issues.description: Set up S3 bucket configuration, upload handler, and deletion logic for video storage.
acceptance_criteria: S3 bucket created with CORS and access policies
Upload handler validates file type and size

issues.title: Video Strategy: Implement Presigned URL Generation
issues.description: Generate temporary presigned URLs for S3 video access with configurable expiration.
acceptance_criteria: URL includes user ID in query for analytics
Backend validates user has course access before issuing URL
URL cannot be shared (includes user-specific token)

issues.title: Video Strategy: Build Video Player with Tracking
issues.description: Create custom video player component with playback progress tracking and 95% completion logic.
acceptance_criteria: HTML5 video player with play/pause/scrub controls
Send progress updates to backend every 10 seconds
Pause on blur, resume on focus (time accuracy)

issues.title: Video Strategy: LGPD Compliance for Video Storage
issues.description: Implement LGPD-compliant data retention and right-to-be-forgotten for stored videos.
acceptance_criteria: Video deletion on user request (right to be forgotten)
Audit trail of who accessed which videos
Data retention policy (e.g., delete after 2 years)
Encryption at rest (S3 SSE-S3 or KMS)

issues.title: Video Strategy: HIPAA Compliance for Video Storage
issues.description: Implement HIPAA-compliant access controls, audit logging, and secure deletion for healthcare content.
acceptance_criteria: Access control: only enrolled users can view
Audit log: WHO accessed WHAT WHEN (immutable)
Regular penetration testing and security audits

issues.title: Analytics: Implement Completion Rate Dashboard
issues.description: Manager dashboard showing completion rates per course with user-level drill-down.
acceptance_criteria: Overview showing X% of users completed course

issues.title: Notifications: Implement Email Notification System
issues.description: Centralized email notification service for course enrollment, completion, certificates, and reminders.
acceptance_criteria: Remind users of upcoming deadlines (7 days, 1 day)
